title: His uncle built India's hybrid seed industry, then sold it all to fund rural development
sources: American Bazaar, May 2026 - From villages to vision: Jay Sehgal on transforming rural India through philanthropy
Indiaspora - Suri and Edda Sehgal, philanthropy leader profile
caption:
His uncle built India's hybrid seed industry. Then he sold it all to fund rural development.

Dr. Suri Sehgal, a Harvard-trained crop scientist, built Proagro Group and Hytech Seed India into major hybrid seed companies before selling them in 1998 and founding the S M Sehgal Foundation in 1999 with his wife Edda. His nephew, Jay Sehgal, became Chairperson of the foundation in April 2025, carrying the work forward across more than 3,000 villages in 13 states - focused on rural water security, sustainable agriculture, women's empowerment and school development.

He built a seed business that fed India's farms. His family then spent the proceeds making sure those farms had water, schools and a future.
